description: One media provider capability record (CF-WO-P1-004, Task I). Providers are separate from reasoning hosts: a host reasons, a provider executes media work. A provider is matched only on capabilities this record actually evidences — never on a claimed capability, never on a manifest alone. Conformance status: VERIFIED (a formal conformance test passed), EXERCISED (the capability was exercised in a recorded run, but no formal conformance test exists), NOT_TESTED (no evidence), FAILED (a conformance test failed). Matching prefers VERIFIED, then EXERCISED; NOT_TESTED and FAILED providers are never matched — tasks for them compile as provider-neutral handoffs. commercial_use_approved is false unless a commercial route was independently cleared; the default OmniVoice weights are CC-BY-NC and must never be routed for monetised or commercial production.

adapter_version.description: Version of the adapter for this provider, when one exists.

audio_capability.description: Whether this provider can handle audio (input or output).

authorization_required.description: Whether using this provider needs user authorization (and, for paid routes, credentials the user supplies).

character_reference_capability.description: Whether this provider can take a character reference and hold the character's identity.

commercial_use_approved.description: Whether this provider is cleared for commercial or monetised production. False unless independently cleared.

commercial_use_reason.description: Why commercial use is approved or not (for example noncommercial_licence, unverified, cleared).

evidence.description: What the conformance claim rests on (for example a recorded run reference, or 'none').

last_verified.description: When the conformance claim was last checked, as a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or 'never'.

test_id.description: The conformance test id, when a formal test exists.

cost_model.description: How this provider charges (for example local-free, paid-per-call, subscription). Paid routes need explicit user authorization before any call.

max_seconds.description: Maximum output duration in seconds, when evidenced.

min_seconds.description: Minimum output duration in seconds, when evidenced.

evidence.description: Pointer to the evidence for this record (file, run reference, or 'documented-only').

input_constraints.description: What this provider accepts as input.

licence.description: Licence or terms governing this provider's outputs (for example CC-BY-NC, AGPL-3.0, proprietary-paid).

native_camera_controls.description: Native camera controls this provider actually supports (empty when none are evidenced — never claimed).

native_motion_controls.description: Native motion controls this provider actually supports (empty when none are evidenced).

operations.description: Operations this provider can perform (for example generate-speech, generate-video, assemble-timeline).

output_constraints.description: What this provider produces, and its limits.

privacy_transmission.description: Privacy and transmission requirements (for example local-only, transmission-to-provider-requires-authorization). Private character images or voice samples are never sent to a provider without authorization.

provider_type.description: What kind of media work this provider does.

reference_image_capability.description: Whether this provider can take a reference image.

title: Provider Capability
